name: Somerset Cider
desc: Cloudy farm cider from the orchards south of Bristol, pressed from bittersweet apples like Dabinett and Kingston Black. Restores 70 HP.

name: St Nick's Pie
desc: Steak and cider under a proper pastry lid, from a stall in St Nicholas Market. Built for the drizzle. Restores 100 HP.

name: Bristol Chocolate Bar
desc: J. S. Fry and Sons of Bristol made the first moulded chocolate bar in 1847. This one is a tribute. Restores 10 PP to every move.

name: Brunel's Top Hat
desc: A tall stovepipe hat like the one Isambard Kingdom Brunel wore in his famous photograph by the launching chains of the Great Eastern. Very good for thinking in.
msg: {name}'s Top Hat lent it a little engineering genius!

name: Peregrine Feather
desc: A barred grey flight feather, moulted on a ledge of the Avon Gorge. The peregrine is the fastest animal on Earth.
effect_text: Speed up when it first comes out.
msg: {name}'s Peregrine Feather sent it off like a shot!
